name: Save newsletter email design
description: Call this when an existing newsletter/email-campaign design must be overwritten with a new drag-and-drop editor document, and you need the rendered HTML back. The newsletter must already exist and its numeric editor id must be known — this action replaces the whole stored design, it does not create one, so use the campaign-creation action (e.g. email_campaign.create_regular) first to obtain an id, and use the campaign-sending action (e.g. campaigns.send_now) when the goal is delivery rather than editing. Prefer a read-only preview or recipient-count action when you only need to inspect a campaign without changing it.
preconditions: The newsletter must already exist and be addressable by the numeric id in the path.
The caller must be authenticated for the account that owns the newsletter.
The request body must carry a complete editor document, because the stored design is replaced rather than patched.

id.description: Path parameter. Numeric id of the newsletter whose design is being replaced, e.g. 2 or 3.

source.description: Query parameter identifying the editor that produced the document. Observed value: reactDnD.

makeScreenshot.description: Query parameter. When true, the server also generates a thumbnail/screenshot of the saved design.

saveEditorVersion.description: Query parameter. When true, the editor version used for this save is recorded alongside the design.

content.description: The complete drag-and-drop editor document to store for this newsletter.

author.description: Author label stored with the design; observed as an empty string.

body.description: Root of the editor document tree.

content.description: Ordered list of editor nodes. Each node nests further nodes via its own 'content' field and carries presentation metadata such as 'type' (e.g. "text"), 'title', 'align', 'label', 'isEmpty', and a 'layout' map keyed by breakpoint (e.g. "default", "320px") holding CSS-like properties. Text nodes hold an HTML string in 'content' and may contain template placeholders such as {{ mirror }}.

html.description: The full rendered email HTML document for the saved design, including doctype, head styles and the campaign subject in the title.

side_effects: The newsletter's stored design is overwritten with the submitted editor document; the previous design is replaced.
The rendered HTML for the newsletter is regenerated, so any later preview, test send, or actual send uses the new content.
When makeScreenshot is true, a thumbnail/screenshot of the design is generated and stored.
When saveEditorVersion is true, the editor version is recorded for the newsletter.
